@graph.headline: Read AI Pricing in 2026: Plans and Costs for US Teams
@graph.description: Read AI pricing in 2026: Free, Pro, Enterprise and Enterprise+ plans explained with monthly and annual costs, free plan limits and team cost examples.

itemListElement.name: Read AI Pricing in 2026: Plans and Costs for US Teams

mainEntity.name: How much does Read AI cost per month?

acceptedAnswer.text: Read AI Pro costs $19.75 per user per month on monthly billing, or $15 per month billed yearly. For Enterprise, it is $29.75 monthly or $22.50 yearly, and Enterprise+ runs $39.75 monthly or $29.75 yearly. With the 25% annual saving, a single Pro user pays $180 a year instead of $237.

mainEntity.name: Is Read AI free to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Read AI's free plan covers 5 meeting transcripts, 5 reports and 5 live-note sessions a month, each up to 1 hour long, with no file uploads. That suits testing Read AI on your most important calls; anyone with daily meetings will hit the limit within the first week.

mainEntity.name: Does Read AI cost money for teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Teams pay per user, so a 10-person team pays $1,800 a year on Pro with annual billing, or $2,370 with monthly billing. Enterprise needs at least 5 licenses. For the same 10 people it costs $2,700 billed yearly and adds audio and video playback.

mainEntity.name: What is Read AI Enterprise pricing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Read AI Enterprise costs $22.50 per user per month billed yearly or $29.75 monthly, with a 5-license minimum. Enterprise+ runs $29.75 yearly or $39.75 monthly. Even a team of 3 that wants Enterprise features pays for 5 seats, so small teams usually stay on Pro.

mainEntity.name: Is Read AI cheaper than Otter?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Otter Pro costs $8.33 a month billed yearly, compared with $15 for Read AI Pro. Monthly, it is $16.99 against $19.75. The free plans differ too: Otter gives 300 minutes a month at 30 minutes per call, while Read AI gives 5 meetings at up to 1 hour.

mainEntity.name: Does Read AI offer a discount for annual billing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Annual billing saves 25% on every paid plan. Pro drops from $19.75 to $15 per user per month, Enterprise from $29.75 to $22.50, and Enterprise+ from $39.75 to $29.75. Unsure?
